text: Dear Members of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee, The Terms of Reference for the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee state that the Committee will hold up to two meetings per year at the call of the Chair or Vice-Chair on the delegation of the Chair. On October 11 and 12, 2023, City Council considered item ST3.1 and adopted the meeting schedule for 2024 for City Council and its Committees. The schedule of meetings for the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid days of cultural or religious significance. The Chair has scheduled the following meetings for 2024: Date: April 8, 2024 Time: 9:30 a.m. Date: October 17, 2024 Time: 9:30 a.m.
The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Expressed its support for holding more than two meetings of the Committee per year.
